# Layerum

> Layerum is a control-first RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) platform. Teams model their organization as a hierarchy of entities inside a workspace, ingest documents (files, URLs, raw text) into those entities, and query them through a public REST API or the TypeScript SDK. Retrieval is limited by entity scope, role permissions and scoped API keys. Model providers are bring-your-own-key.

Key facts for agents:

- API base URL: the backend URL of this Layerum installation, for example `http://localhost:4000`. All public endpoints are under `/v1/*`.
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer lyr_wk_...` (a workspace API key, created in the Layerum app under Workspace -> API Keys).
- API keys carry capabilities (`query:read`, `data:ingest`, `config:manage`) and entity/model scopes, all enforced server-side.
- Official SDK: `npm i @layerum-team/rag-sdk` (TypeScript/JavaScript).
- CLI and MCP server for people and AI assistants (OAuth sign-in, not API keys): `npm i -g @layerum-team/cli`.
- To answer a question from a workspace's knowledge: `POST /v1/query`.

## Docs

- [Public API reference](/llms/api.md): every `/v1` endpoint, auth, error format, enums, upload flow, cURL examples
- [SDK reference](/llms/sdk.md): `@layerum-team/rag-sdk` client options, methods, types, error handling
- [CLI and MCP reference](/llms/cli.md): `@layerum-team/cli` install, OAuth login, commands, MCP server setup and tools, environment variables
- [Quick start](/docs): create an API key, install the SDK, first calls
- [Core concepts](/docs/concepts): workspaces, entity hierarchy, scopes
- [Reference (HTML)](/docs/reference): the same API and SDK reference as a web page
